name: Mergify Shopify order-combining app
demand: Shopify reported millions of merchants in more than 175 countries as of 31 December 2025, but this broad platform total does not establish demand for order merging (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1594805/000159480526000007/shop-20251231.htm). The Flippa listing claims 3,060 active subscribers, with no measurement date or public install data (https://flippa.com/12766656-mergify-is-a-shopify-app-that-combines-multiple-customer-orders-into-one-shipment-helping-stores-save-on-shipping-costs). Shopify’s current listing shows 4.6/5 from 64 reviews, while Flippa’s description says 4.7/5 from 96 reviews (https://apps.shopify.com/bestapper-mergify; https://flippa.com/12766656-mergify-is-a-shopify-app-that-combines-multiple-customer-orders-into-one-shipment-helping-stores-save-on-shipping-costs). An AppJubilee crawl dated 21 October 2026 ranks Mergify first for “merge orders,” but gives no keyword search volume; search volume and current install count are unverified (https://www.appjubilee.io/tools/shopify-app-keyword-research/merge-orders).
prices: Mergify currently offers a free-to-install plan and paid tiers at $9.99, $29.99, and $49.99/month (https://apps.shopify.com/bestapper-mergify). Direct alternatives include Triom with a free plan (https://apps.shopify.com/order-merger), MergeIt with six free monthly merges and a $14.99/month paid tier (https://apps.shopify.com/mergeit-combine-merge-orders), and Order Merger by BoostApps with a free plan and paid tiers from $6.99 to $29.99/month (https://apps.shopify.com/order-merger-1). Newer MergeShip lists $19/month (https://apps.shopify.com/mergeship). These prices leave little room to defend the feature on price alone.

revenue_proof.claim: Flippa currently displays $645,000 asking price, $11,393/month profit, 3,060 active subscribers, and 4% overall churn. Its public description separately claims $138,000 revenue and $115,500 net profit over the past year, and $12,900 MRR. Flippa says revenue, primary expenses, and traffic were reviewed, but its buyer guidance also says financials are seller-provided and advises buyers to request source records. The underlying reporting period, as-of date, churn definition, and source statements are not public, so current revenue and churn are not independently verified. Arithmetic: $645,000 is 5.58× the stated $115,500 annual profit; it is about 4.72× twelve times the displayed $11,393 monthly profit, consistent with the displayed 4.7× multiple. The different bases need reconciliation.
revenue_proof.claim_event_date: Unverified: the description says “over the past year” but gives no start/end dates or measurement cutoff.

copy_speed: Direct copy is already visible: Order Merger by BoostApps launched 9 May 2026, Combine Orders & Ship Together launched 19 May 2026, and MergeShip launched 29 September 2026; each offers order-combining functionality (https://apps.shopify.com/order-merger-1; https://apps.shopify.com/combine-orders-ship-together; https://apps.shopify.com/mergeship). Two launched at lower prices than Mergify’s paid plans, and MergeShip lists $19/month. This shows fast entry into the feature niche, not a verified estimate of competitors’ development time.
platform_risk: High Shopify dependency. The Partner Program Agreement says an acquisition or change of control is a transfer requiring Shopify’s prior written consent, which Shopify may withhold; the API Terms also make the API license non-transferable and revocable (https://www.shopify.com/ng/partners/terms; https://www.shopify.com/legal/api-terms). Shopify reserves the right to change or discontinue API access or features (https://www.shopify.com/legal/api-terms). Mergify’s App Store disclosure includes access to customer data and all order history, and permission to edit orders (https://apps.shopify.com/bestapper-mergify). Shopify’s API includes a fulfillment-order merge mutation, but that is not evidence of native merging of customer orders (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2026-04/mutations/fulfillmentOrderMerge). The Built for Shopify badge is a positive listing signal, not a transfer guarantee or protection from platform changes (https://apps.shopify.com/bestapper-mergify).
defensible_asset: The plausible moat is weak workflow switching friction: Mergify is embedded in Shopify Admin and has merchant-defined filtering rules, merge settings, and merge history (https://docs.mergify.app/). Replacing it may require reconfiguring those settings and changing fulfillment habits. There is no public evidence of a proprietary cross-merchant dataset or network effect, and direct alternatives offer similar features, including free options (https://apps.shopify.com/order-merger; https://apps.shopify.com/mergeit-combine-merge-orders). The claimed 4% churn is undated and unverified, so it does not establish meaningful lock-in.
build_effort: The existing business avoids a greenfield build, but public sources do not reveal its codebase, architecture, deployment process, incident history, or backlog, so acquisition handover and maintenance effort are unverified. The product handles automated and manual order merges, rules, history, and order-data permissions (https://docs.mergify.app/; https://apps.shopify.com/bestapper-mergify). An AI-agent-run operator could draft routine support replies, documentation, listing updates, and test plans; reliable order mutations, API upgrades, security, production releases, and exceptional fulfillment cases still need technical oversight. Shopify’s current API Terms restrict using Shopify-derived merchant data to train or improve AI systems without Shopify’s or the relevant merchant’s consent (https://www.shopify.com/legal/api-terms).
channel: For acquisition, use the existing Flippa marketplace listing; it is an inbound sale listing, not customer cold outreach (https://flippa.com/12766656-mergify-is-a-shopify-app-that-combines-multiple-customer-orders-into-one-shipment-helping-stores-save-on-shipping-costs). For customers, use Shopify App Store search and ads, SEO, and opt-in integration partnerships; Mergify lists Shopify Flow, ShipBob, and ShipStation integrations (https://apps.shopify.com/bestapper-mergify). Shopify permits App Store ads for published apps and eligible Partners (https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/launch/marketing/advertising). UK ICO guidance says PECR’s electronic-marketing rules cover calls, email, text, and other stored direct messages; online advertising is outside those specific message rules, though UK GDPR and cookie requirements may still apply (https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/guide-to-pecr/electronic-and-telephone-marketing/). For other countries, ad, privacy, and platform-rule compliance must be checked locally.
owner_hours_per_week: The seller says support takes less than 20 hours/week, mainly customer service, but does not disclose actual owner hours or show that the work can be reduced to 5 hours/week (https://flippa.com/12766656-mergify-is-a-shopify-app-that-combines-multiple-customer-orders-into-one-shipment-helping-stores-save-on-shipping-costs). The hard cap is unverified and the listing does not pass it as presented.
automation_reason: 35% is my rough estimate, not a measured listing metric. Generic FAQ drafting, support triage, routine reporting, and marketing-content drafts are plausible agent tasks, but the listing says support is primarily customer service and less than 20 hours/week (https://flippa.com/12766656-mergify-is-a-shopify-app-that-combines-multiple-customer-orders-into-one-shipment-helping-stores-save-on-shipping-costs). Production changes and cases involving customer/order data need human controls; Shopify’s current API Terms restrict training or improving AI systems with Shopify-derived merchant data absent the required consent (https://www.shopify.com/legal/api-terms). This estimate does not meet the 50% automation constraint.
listing_check: Revenue/expenses: Flippa marks revenue, primary expenses, and traffic reviewed, but public evidence is seller-provided narrative; dated source statements are not available without further diligence (https://flippa.com/12766656-mergify-is-a-shopify-app-that-combines-multiple-customer-orders-into-one-shipment-helping-stores-save-on-shipping-costs). Churn: 4% claimed, but period and calculation unverified at the same URL. Owner hours: support workload stated as less than 20 hours/week; no <=5-hour owner figure. Price/profit: $645,000 equals 5.58× the described $115,500 annual net profit, or about 4.72× annualized current displayed monthly profit of $11,393; the public page does not reconcile the bases. Transferability: not confirmed; Shopify’s agreement requires prior written consent for assignment/transfer, including acquisition or change of control (https://www.shopify.com/ng/partners/terms). Seller dependence: listing says technical support is offered to a non-technical buyer, but duration, staffing, handover scope, and ongoing seller reliance are unverified (https://flippa.com/12766656-mergify-is-a-shopify-app-that-combines-multiple-customer-orders-into-one-shipment-helping-stores-save-on-shipping-costs).
moat_assessment: Only a thin switching-cost case: saved rules, merge history, Shopify Admin placement, and fulfillment integrations could create some friction (https://docs.mergify.app/; https://apps.shopify.com/bestapper-mergify). Public evidence does not show that this friction is costly to overcome; competing apps launched in 2026 with similar functionality and lower or free pricing (https://apps.shopify.com/order-merger-1; https://apps.shopify.com/combine-orders-ship-together; https://apps.shopify.com/mergeship). The claimed low churn is not dated or verified. I would not count this as a strong defensible moat before seeing cohort retention and merchant switching evidence.
desk_test: One-day, no-ad-spend test: create a Shopify Partner development store, install Mergify’s free plan, and run test orders through manual merge, rules-based suggestions, auto-merge, undo, inventory, and fulfillment flows; Shopify describes development stores as app-testing environments, and Mergify offers five free trial merges (https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/stores/development-stores; https://docs.mergify.app/plans/). In parallel, use the Flippa listing’s inquiry/data-room route to request dated monthly Shopify Partner payout and subscription reports, churn/install-uninstall exports, expense records, support-hour breakdown, source-code/deployment access, and written Shopify confirmation of the transfer path. Do not rely on a successful sandbox test as revenue proof.
red_flags: Hard-constraint mismatch: support is stated as less than 20 hours/week, no <=5-hour owner workload is evidenced, and my automation estimate is below 50% (https://flippa.com/12766656-mergify-is-a-shopify-app-that-combines-multiple-customer-orders-into-one-shipment-helping-stores-save-on-shipping-costs). Stale or inconsistent public claims: Flippa says 4.7/96 reviews while Shopify currently shows 4.6/64; Flippa describes $115,500 yearly net but the current teaser shows $11,393/month profit; the periods are not dated (https://flippa.com/12766656-mergify-is-a-shopify-app-that-combines-multiple-customer-orders-into-one-shipment-helping-stores-save-on-shipping-costs; https://apps.shopify.com/bestapper-mergify). The seller-described 30% revenue drop is dated September 2023, more than 18 months old, so I assign it zero weight under the stated rule (https://flippa.com/12766656-mergify-is-a-shopify-app-that-combines-multiple-customer-orders-into-one-shipment-helping-stores-save-on-shipping-costs). Transfer needs written Shopify consent, current transferability is unverified (https://www.shopify.com/ng/partners/terms).
